seoTitle: About FilmEditRun | Video Production Cambridge & London
seoDescription: Meet FilmEditRun: an independent video production studio and post-house based in Cambridge. Filming conferences, brand stories, and podcasts across the UK.
headline: Films crafted with care, <br class="hidden sm:inline" />clarity, and *purpose*.
manifestoLead: Operating with agile crews on-location, we partner directly with your team from concept to final delivery. Technical precision, transparent communication, and a disciplined workflow built around your schedule.
manifestoQuote: Every project deserves a dedicated filmmaker who listens closely and cuts with discipline. Direct collaboration from initial brief to final delivery.
approachBody: With FilmEditRun, we listen to your brief, direct the narrative, and cut the story. Direct communication, honest guidance, and zero translation loss.
timelineHeading: Ten years behind the lens. *Built for today.*
timelineDescription: A decade of on-location filming and live conference production, refined into an agile independent studio.
